pages.title: Unspool Art
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Send colored thread from bobbins to matching spools in Unspool Art. Watch the picture emerge as you fill and clear the spools. Check which colors can go straight to a spool before tapping, since you can get stuck if the buffer runs out of room.

pages.title: Shadows of the Forest: Reign of Triduja
pages.creator: Rabbit Bay Games
pages.description: Search dark woods for totem fragments in Shadows of the Forest: Reign of Triduja. A breakdown leaves you stranded in the realm, and rebuilding the totem is your way out. Explore from a first-person view and pay attention to your surroundings as you look for the pieces.

pages.title: The Noob Aventures
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Look for diamonds and rescue friends in The Noob Aventures. Work through 70 levels, fighting enemies and finding ways past traps that block the route. Use the diamonds you collect to unlock new characters before taking them into the next part of the adventure.

pages.title: Cake Sort
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Choose from three stacks on the tray in Cake Sort and place them on the table. Set identical cakes next to one another so they merge into taller stacks and earn points. Think about which plate to use, since the run ends when the table fills up.

pages.title: Challenge Your Friends
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Pick a head-to-head game in Challenge Your Friends. Try Drunken Duel, Tug The Table, Stick Duel, or Milk The Cow, and add a dare if you want to raise the stakes. There are seven games for competing with friends and six you can play solo.

pages.title: RPG Idle Clicker
pages.creator: Magikon Games
pages.description: Tap to attack monsters and earn gold in RPG Idle Clicker. Upgrade swords to make each tap stronger, then recruit heroes who keep attacking on their own, even while you're away. Put your earnings back into the party as you take on tougher monsters and bosses.

pages.title: Donne's Spinning World
pages.creator: Done23
pages.description: Turn the world to change gravity in Donne's Spinning World. Use magical leaves to rotate the level, then jump or move boxes to reach flowers that were out of reach. Find every flower while opening doors and steering clear of spikes and roaming monsters.

pages.title: Ellie and Friends Venice Carnival
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress Ellie and her friends for the Venice Carnival. Choose costumes and accessories, then pick a mask to finish each look. Try a different combination for each friend so the group arrives at the celebration in distinct outfits.

pages.title: Water Dig Rescue
pages.creator: Supercode Games
pages.description: Carve a channel through the sand in Water Dig Rescue and send enough water into the waiting truck to clear the level. Think about how the stream will flow before you dig. If you can lead it past the golden balls on the way, you'll earn extra points.

pages.title: Interior Designer - Decor Life
pages.creator: TearForge Studios
pages.description: Drag furnishings into place in Interior Designer - Decor Life. Rotate an item while holding it when it needs to face another direction. Tackle a design challenge when you want a goal, or arrange the space according to your own taste.

pages.title: Meteoheroes
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Train Fulmen, Nix, Nubess, Thermo, Pluvia, and Ventum in Meteoheroes. Each of the six gym games puts a different skill to work, from aiming and speed to strength and coordination. Switch between the exercises to see how each hero uses their powers.

pages.title: Dino Survival: 3D Simulator
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Build a settlement in Dino Survival: 3D Simulator. Tame and raise dinosaurs while exploring unfamiliar territory, then sail to more distant islands. Take on raids and fight predators such as raptors and the T. rex as you expand beyond your starting area.

pages.title: Bus Jam
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Match passengers to buses of the same color in Bus Jam. Look at the bus that's ready to board and decide whom to send first. Work through the crowd in an order that gets each passenger onto the right bus and clears the stop.

pages.title: Lazy Workers
pages.creator: Liones Games
pages.description: Get a sleepy office back to work in Lazy Workers. Use the mouse to send employees toward the desks, arranging their paths so they don't run into each other. The layouts get harder as you advance, and you can skip a level if you get stuck.

pages.title: Horse Champs
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Raise and train a horse in Horse Champs before entering it in a race. Think about how to prepare your horse, then see how it fares against the other runners. Keep working on your approach as you aim for a first-place finish.

pages.title: Anaconda Runner
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pick up blue balls as you steer a snake along the course in Anaconda Runner. Each one helps the snake grow, so look ahead to choose a route that takes you through more of them. See how large you can make the anaconda by the end of the run.

pages.title: Dream Wedding Planner
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Plan a wedding for one of four characters in Dream Wedding Planner. Work through six parts of the preparations, choosing details and using the tools in each scene. Follow the pink arrow if you want to skip a step, or print the design after you've finished it.

pages.title: Nail Challenge
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Build a team and race to hammer nails into wood in Nail Challenge. Take advantage of golden nails for extra power and look for new teammates in the shop. Between matches, use the bonus rounds to smash wood and collect more coins.

pages.title: Humans Playground
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Set up physics experiments with ragdolls in Humans Playground. Place characters and objects in the open space, then see how the scene reacts when you use tools that burn, crush, or otherwise affect them. Rearrange the setup to try a different outcome.

pages.title: Anime Avatar - Face Maker
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Create a character portrait in Anime Avatar - Face Maker. Choose a hairstyle, expression, clothing, and accessories, then see how they look together. Build a fairy, an anime princess, or another character of your own as you try different combinations.

pages.title: Fuel Rage
pages.creator: Melon Gaming
pages.description: Guide a car from above in Fuel Rage. Watch the road ahead and steer around obstacles as the race moves quickly. Look for a clear route before you move, and see how high a score you can reach by keeping the car going.

pages.title: SnipNdrop
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Tap a ball to start it moving in SnipNdrop, then tap again to drop it into the basket. Watch how the ball swings or rolls and think about where it will go once you release it. Try to guide as many balls into the basket as you can.

pages.title: Is It Golf
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Aim for the flag in Is It Golf, even when you're launching a sheep, a car, or a chicken instead of a golf ball. Adjust the power of each shot and give the drums a wide berth. Get the object to the marked flag to finish the hole.

pages.title: Mahjong 3D
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Look for matching symbols in the three-dimensional layout of Mahjong 3D. Check the board from different angles and look for tiles with open sides. If a pair is blocked, remove neighboring tiles first to give yourself more choices.

pages.title: MY CUTE PET
pages.creator: TWO PLAYERS GAME STUDIO
pages.description: Flip cards to reveal animals in MY CUTE PET. Remember where you saw each animal and use that information to find its partner. More cards and new pictures appear as you advance, so you'll have more positions to keep track of on later boards.

pages.title: Elon Cars: Push and Drop
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Watch the power meter in Elon Cars: Push and Drop and launch your sedan when it reaches the red zone. A well-timed press sends the car off faster, setting up the crash that follows. See how changing the timing changes what happens on the next launch.

pages.title: Rope Draw
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Push ropes to copy the pattern shown above the board in Rope Draw. Use a hint to see the opening moves if you get stuck. There are 120 puzzles, and finishing level 40 unlocks a mode where you can add ropes and move them freely.

pages.title: Tropical Merge
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Combine items as you restore an island farm in Tropical Merge. Help the locals look after their bay and grow the farm as more of the island opens up. Take expeditions to other islands when you want to see what else is waiting to be solved.

pages.title: Halloween Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Rebuild a spooky picture from scattered pieces in Halloween Puzzle. Look at the edges and details in each piece to work out where it fits. Move through the Halloween scenes and try different ways of finishing the current layout when a section has you stuck.

pages.title: Idle Superpowers
pages.creator: Lutz Schönfelder
pages.description: Build a superhero from randomly offered abilities in Idle Superpowers. Combine powers that work well together and see how the build handles a changing set of enemies and items. Try a different approach in the next run or complete challenges to unlock upgrades.

pages.title: Tetra Blocks
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Stack falling shapes to fill complete rows in Tetra Blocks. Look for a place each piece can fit before it lands, and use cleared rows to make room for what comes next. Keep going as the levels advance and try to improve your score.

pages.title: Jurassic Theft
pages.creator: playfreeonline.games
pages.description: Help a time-traveling professor collect dinosaur eggs in Jurassic Theft. Watch for Velociraptors on the ground, Mosasaurus in the water, and Pterodactyls overhead. Find a route through the platforms that reaches the eggs while keeping the professor away from the dinosaurs.

pages.title: Street Racer Underground
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Customize a car and take it onto the streets in Street Racer Underground. Reach checkpoints in the endless mode, escape police pursuit, or compete in four racing events. Build up your nitro and time the boost for a stretch where you can make use of the extra speed.

pages.title: Mobile Phone Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick a phone illustration and give it your own colors in Mobile Phone Coloring Book. Use the drawing and painting tools to fill in the design. Try a different color scheme or choose another image when you're ready to start a new picture.

pages.title: Route Digger 2
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Dig a tunnel to guide a ball into a matching well in Route Digger 2. Look at the well's color and position before you start cutting through the earth. Shape a path that lets the ball roll down to the right destination.

pages.title: Bow Master Online
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Choose one of six archers in Bow Master Online. On your turn, drag to set the angle and power, then release to fire at the other archer. Play offline or look for an online opponent. The game supplies a bot if it can't find another player.

pages.title: Girl Dressup Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Style a character for a family holiday in Girl Dressup Deluxe. Try different clothes, hairstyles, and accessories until the pieces work together. When you're happy with the outfit, you can save or print a picture of the finished look.

pages.title: Neko Pachinko
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Turn the wheel in Neko Pachinko to adjust how hard you launch the balls. Watch them fall through the board and try to reach the lucky holes. A successful drop can take you to a bonus round where three matching symbols earn an in-game prize.

pages.title: Moto Rush
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Keep a motorcycle running as long as possible in Moto Rush. Aim for speed boosts and use ramps to jump, then get ready for the landing. Watch the track ahead so you can stay on the bike and build a higher score.

pages.title: Buddy Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fit pieces together to rebuild pictures in Buddy Jigsaw Puzzle. Choose easy, medium, or hard before starting the puzzle. Use the picture details and the shape of each piece to work out what belongs together, then join the sections you've completed.

pages.title: Princess Fashion Nail Art DIY Blog
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help Elsa put together a post in Princess Fashion Nail Art DIY Blog. Choose a nail look and a fashion style for her to feature, then see how the two work together. Try another combination when you want a different look for the blog.

pages.title: Jet Ski Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of six jet ski pictures in Jet Ski Puzzle and put it back together. Play with 16 pieces or try a 36-, 64-, or 100-piece version. Look at the details in the water and the jet ski to work out where the pieces belong.

pages.title: Motocross Beach Jumping Bike Stunt Game
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Ride a dirt bike through beach tracks in Motocross Beach Jumping Bike Stunt Game. Try flips and wheelies for points while keeping the bike on the path. Balance speed with control so you can land your tricks and reach the finish quickly.

pages.title: Wild Push
pages.creator: Enrich Games
pages.description: Find a way through the marching penguins in Wild Push. Look for a gap in the crowd and move through before the penguins close it. Keep working your way past the groups until you can cross the finish line.

pages.title: Speedy Corona Virus.IO
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Steer through a virus-themed arena in Speedy Corona Virus.IO. Use the mouse to guide your character around the other fast-moving viruses. Watch the space ahead so you can change direction before you get boxed in, and try to stay in play as the arena gets crowded.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Lighthouse Adventure
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Join Baby Hazel on a cruise in Baby Hazel Lighthouse Adventure. Help her swim and dance aboard the ship, then follow her when a lighthouse catches her eye. Explore the new place with Hazel as her wish to visit the lighthouse becomes part of a dream.

pages.title: FZ PinBall
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Keep a steel ball in play in FZ PinBall. Move the paddle into position to send the ball back around the machine and earn points from the bounces. You get three balls, so keep an eye on where the current one is headed as it comes back down.

pages.title: Alphabet Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Jump across the letters in alphabetical order in Alphabet Jump. Click to guide the jumper to the next letter and keep following the sequence toward the finish. Check the letter you need before each jump so you stay on the right path.

pages.title: Real City Truck Simulator
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Find a load and deliver it before time expires in Real City Truck Simulator. Watch the surrounding traffic as you move between pickup and drop-off points. Try four different trucks or switch to a night mode to make the city route feel different.

pages.title: Math Quiz Game
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Answer arithmetic questions in Math Quiz Game. Read each problem, work out the result, and choose the answer that fits. Use the next question to see how quickly you can recognize the calculation you need.

pages.title: My Ice Cream Maker
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Create an ice cream dessert in My Ice Cream Maker. Choose the flavors you want to combine and finish the serving with colorful garnishes. Try a different flavor and topping combination when you want to make another version.

pages.title: Island Clean Truck Garbage Sim
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Take a garbage truck around the island in Island Clean Truck Garbage Sim. Drive to the areas that need cleaning and collect the waste you find. Work through eight missions as the island's new garbage truck driver.

pages.title: Max Drift Car Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Pick a car and drift through an open city in Max Drift Car Simulator. Try to hold a slide as you turn through the streets, or use the open areas to practice stunts. Watch for other traffic before taking a corner at speed.

pages.title: Crazy Gerbil Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Choose from eight gerbil illustrations in Crazy Gerbil Coloring. Pick colors for the details and try different palettes on the drawings. Use the camera button to download the finished picture when you want to save or share it.

pages.title: Lets Paint Together
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Work out which paths to paint in Lets Paint Together. Use the mouse to send the painters along their routes and look for stretches that still need color. Tackle the painting puzzles on your own or play with a friend.

pages.title: Boss Business Inc.
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Run an office in Boss Business Inc. Hire employees and decide whether to approve their requests. Each decision can affect how people feel about work, so pay attention to motivation. See what happens around the office when it drops too far.

pages.title: Smarty Tractor
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drive a tractor over every part of the field in Smarty Tractor. Plan a route that covers all the spaces without crossing any of them twice. More than 50 puzzles introduce changing field conditions, so look for a path that leaves a way to reach the last patch.

pages.title: Find 5 Differences Halloween
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare two Halloween pictures in Find 5 Differences Halloween. Look for small changes between the images and mark each one you spot. Scan the same part of both pictures when you need another clue, and find at least five differences to meet the goal.

pages.title: Neon Strike
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Match each incoming square to the line's color in Neon Strike. The line switches between red and blue, so check the square before it reaches it. Each correct contact earns a point. Keep the colors in sync as you try to build a higher score.

pages.title: Nadja DressUp
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Pick an outfit for Nadja's modeling party in Nadja DressUp. Try different combinations and see what suits the event before settling on a look. Put the pieces together to get Nadja ready for the party.

pages.title: Sand Balls
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Dig through the sand to send small balls into a waiting truck in Sand Balls. Shape a path that lets more of them roll down to the truck. Work through 100 levels and see how many balls you can deliver on each layout.

pages.title: Juice Fresh
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Swipe through matching fruit in Juice Fresh to clear it from the board. Work through 100 levels and see how your score compares on the leaderboard. A failed level can cost a life, and the timer at the top shows when the next one will be available.

pages.title: Impossible Lite Dash
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Shift a small square from side to side in Impossible Lite Dash. Watch the obstacles ahead and switch sides before the square hits one. Try to find the next safe opening quickly enough to keep moving along the course.

pages.title: Angry Chicken Egg Madness
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Catch falling eggs in Angry Chicken Egg Madness while avoiding the things that get in your way. Look for eggs with special powers. The ninja egg lets you swipe through other eggs before they land, giving you a different way to keep up with the falling targets.

pages.title: World Cup Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Compare two World Cup pictures and mark the differences before time expires in World Cup Differences. Look for details that appear in one image but change in the other. A faster finish earns a higher score, and you can use the Hint button if you're stuck.

pages.title: Rolling Ball
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Slide tiles to make a route for the ball in Rolling Ball. Look at the grooves on each tile and move them into positions where the ends connect. Use the mouse to rearrange the pieces until the ball has a continuous path to its destination.

pages.title: Space Adventure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Swap neighboring pieces in Space Adventure to line up at least three of the same color. Clearing a match changes the board, so check the space-themed layout again before choosing another move. Keep looking for rows and columns where one swap will complete a group.

pages.title: Zombie Shooter Deluxe
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Shoot zombies to build your score in Zombie Shooter Deluxe. Keep looking for the next target as the zombies come into view. Clear as many as you can during the fight and try to improve your score as you get faster at picking them off.

pages.title: Taxi Driver
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pick up passengers and drive them to their destinations in Taxi Driver. Steer and control your speed with WASD, and press C to change your view when you need a different angle. The game has two cars and several levels to drive through.

pages.title: Aliens Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Aim and fire bubbles in Aliens Bubble Shooter to make groups of three or more of the same kind. Look for shots that leave you room to reach another group, and watch for the alien bubbles that can add extra points.

pages.title: Emoji Pong
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Move the paddle to keep the ball from hitting the ground in Emoji Pong. Use the bounces to hit emojis and earn points. The game gets faster as you go, so move into position early enough to return the next bounce.

pages.title: Devil Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Aim colored bubbles in Devil Bubble Shooter and use the walls to reach awkward targets. Look for a shot that connects with matching bubbles higher in the layout. Try a different angle when there isn't a direct route to the group you want.

pages.title: HidJigs Christmas
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Choose between finding hidden objects and completing jigsaws in HidJigs Christmas. Both modes have sixteen Christmas-themed levels. Work through either collection and compare your finish times with the best ones the game saved from earlier attempts.

pages.title: Design My Shoes
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create three pairs of shoes in Design My Shoes. Each pair is for a different event, so choose details that suit the occasion and try a new look for the next design. Present all three pairs to the jury when they're ready.

pages.title: Dress Up Competition
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style five contestants in Dress Up Competition. Check the event each look is meant for, then choose clothes that fit it. Once the contestants are ready, see what the judges think and find out who takes first place.

pages.title: Adam and Eve 4
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help Adam find his true love in Adam and Eve 4. Click or tap characters and objects to see how they change the scene. Work out what needs to happen before Adam can move on, then follow him into the next puzzle.

pages.title: Annie Vs Ellie
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pick outfits for both princesses in Annie Vs Ellie. Try different looks on Ellie and Annie and put together the combinations you want them to wear in the fashion battle. See which princess wins after you've styled both of them.

pages.title: Princess Fidget Spinners
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Get Cinderella, Elena of Avalor, and Elsa ready for a fidget spinner contest in Princess Fidget Spinners. Choose clothes and accessories that give each contestant her own style. Once their looks are ready, put their spinners to work in the competition.

pages.title: Water Park Visit
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help the princesses pick swimsuits for a day out in Water Park Visit. Start in the park shop and try different combinations of swimwear and accessories. Put together a look for each princess before the group heads out to enjoy the water park.

pages.title: 3D Mahjong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Look for matching tiles in the three-dimensional layouts of 3D Mahjong. Check the board from different perspectives to spot pieces you couldn't see at first. Work through a layout by removing pairs, then try a different arrangement when you've cleared it.

pages.title: Elsa and Jack Ice Ballet
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Help Elsa find what she needs before the show in Elsa and Jack Ice Ballet. Search her room for hidden belongings, then choose a ballet costume with accessories and shoes. Get her things together and finish the outfit before she goes on.
